symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1652: `check -p --references` passed a microflow in an ordinary module that did `retrieve $l from AddOn.Internal` or `$i = create AddOn.Internal` on a Hidden entity of a Protected (add-on) module; mx check refused it with CE1406 (Retrieve object(s) activity / Create object activity … is not allowed to use entity)
cause: checkFlow checked an entity only in a flow's parameter and return types, and checkFlowMembers checked the members a CreateObjectStmt assigns and a RetrieveStmt's XPath names, but not s.EntityType / s.Source. A bare create or a retrieve without where reached no check
insight: CE1406 is raised per element a flow names, not per member: every place a flow body names an entity (create, database retrieve) needs the same entityRef call the signature gets. entityRef already folds in the script-stated, stored and created-by-script levels, so reuse it rather than a new lookup. An association retrieve names an association, not an entity, and stays with the member check.
